% Pattern: proof/amsthm/amsart. A statement with two proofs, whose heads
% are "Proof 1" and "Proof 2". Both prove the statement.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want prop-1 statement/proposition 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=prop-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=prop-1
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{prop}{Proposition}
\begin{document}
\begin{prop} Each tree with $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges. \end{prop}
\begin{proof}[Proof 1] Remove a leaf and use induction. \end{proof}
\begin{proof}[Proof 2] Count the vertices and the components. \end{proof}
\end{document}
